<documents>
<document id="disputes-duplicate">
ChargedˆtwiceˆforˆtheˆsameˆthingˆSeeingˆtheˆsameˆchargeˆtwiceˆdoesn'tˆalwaysˆmeanˆyouˆwereˆchargedˆtwice.ˆ##ˆCheckˆifˆoneˆisˆpendingˆHotels,ˆgasˆstations,ˆcarˆrentalsˆandˆrestaurantsˆoftenˆplaceˆaˆtemporaryˆauthorization,ˆthenˆpostˆtheˆfinalˆamountˆseparately.ˆTheˆpendingˆoneˆusuallyˆdropsˆoffˆwithinˆ7ˆdays.ˆPendingˆtransactionsˆcan'tˆbeˆdisputed.ˆ##ˆIfˆbothˆhaveˆpostedˆIfˆtwoˆidenticalˆchargesˆhaveˆbothˆposted,ˆcontactˆtheˆmerchantˆfirst.ˆMostˆwillˆrefundˆaˆduplicateˆquickly.ˆIfˆtheˆmerchantˆdoesn'tˆhelp,ˆdisputeˆtheˆsecondˆchargeˆinˆtheˆappˆasˆaˆduplicate.ˆTapˆtheˆtransaction,ˆthenˆGetˆhelp,ˆthenˆChargedˆtwice.ˆ##ˆDuplicateˆfeesˆIfˆweˆchargedˆyouˆtheˆsameˆfeeˆtwice,ˆmessageˆsupport.ˆAˆfeeˆchargedˆinˆerrorˆisˆalwaysˆrefunded.ˆ##ˆTimeˆlimitˆDuplicateˆchargesˆfollowˆtheˆmerchantˆdisputeˆwindow:ˆ120ˆdaysˆfromˆtheˆtransactionˆdate.ˆ##ˆSplitˆpaymentsˆSomeˆmerchantsˆsplitˆoneˆorderˆintoˆseveralˆcharges,ˆforˆexampleˆwhenˆitemsˆshipˆseparately.ˆCheckˆyourˆorderˆconfirmationˆbeforeˆyouˆdispute.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="account-verification-time">
HowˆlongˆverificationˆtakesˆMostˆapplicationsˆareˆverifiedˆwithinˆ1ˆbusinessˆday,ˆandˆmanyˆwithinˆminutes.ˆ##ˆManualˆreviewˆIfˆweˆneedˆtoˆcheckˆsomethingˆbyˆhand,ˆitˆcanˆtakeˆupˆtoˆ5ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆWeˆmayˆaskˆforˆanotherˆdocument,ˆsuchˆasˆproofˆofˆaddress.ˆ##ˆWhileˆyouˆwaitˆYouˆcanˆreceiveˆdepositsˆintoˆyourˆnewˆaccount,ˆbutˆyouˆcan'tˆsendˆmoney,ˆwithdrawˆcashˆorˆorderˆaˆcardˆuntilˆyou'reˆverified.ˆ##ˆCheckingˆstatusˆTheˆappˆshowsˆyourˆverificationˆstatusˆonˆtheˆhomeˆscreen.ˆWe'llˆnotifyˆyouˆasˆsoonˆasˆit'sˆdone.ˆ##ˆCanˆsupportˆspeedˆitˆup?ˆNo.ˆVerificationˆisˆhandledˆbyˆourˆVerificationˆteam,ˆandˆsupportˆcan'tˆapproveˆapplicationsˆorˆtellˆyouˆmoreˆthanˆtheˆappˆshows.ˆIfˆweˆneedˆanythingˆfromˆyou,ˆwe'llˆaskˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆ##ˆCommonˆcausesˆofˆdelaysˆAˆblurryˆIDˆphoto,ˆaˆnameˆthatˆdoesn'tˆmatchˆyourˆIDˆexactly,ˆorˆaˆrecentˆmoveˆareˆtheˆmostˆcommonˆreasonsˆweˆneedˆaˆmanualˆreview.ˆCheckingˆtheseˆbeforeˆyouˆapplyˆhelps.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="card-pin">
SettingˆorˆchangingˆyourˆPINˆYouˆsetˆyourˆPINˆwhenˆyouˆactivateˆyourˆcard,ˆandˆyouˆcanˆchangeˆitˆanyˆtimeˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆ##ˆChangeˆyourˆPINˆ1.ˆTapˆCards,ˆthenˆCardˆsettings.ˆ2.ˆTapˆChangeˆPIN.ˆ3.ˆConfirmˆit'sˆyouˆwithˆyourˆpasscodeˆorˆfaceˆorˆfingerprintˆunlock.ˆ4.ˆEnterˆtheˆnewˆPINˆtwice.ˆTheˆnewˆPINˆworksˆrightˆawayˆatˆcardˆterminals.ˆSomeˆATMsˆoutsideˆtheˆBrookLinkˆnetworkˆonlyˆpickˆupˆtheˆnewˆPINˆafterˆyourˆfirstˆchip-and-PINˆpurchase.ˆ##ˆForgotˆyourˆPINˆUseˆChangeˆPINˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆYouˆdon'tˆneedˆtheˆoldˆone,ˆbecauseˆtheˆappˆalreadyˆknowsˆit'sˆyou.ˆ##ˆLockedˆPINˆAfterˆseveralˆwrongˆtries,ˆATMsˆandˆterminalsˆwillˆrefuseˆtheˆPIN.ˆChangingˆtheˆPINˆinˆtheˆappˆunlocksˆit.ˆ##ˆKeepˆitˆprivateˆTallowbrookˆstaffˆwillˆneverˆaskˆforˆyourˆPIN.ˆSupportˆcan'tˆseeˆitˆeither.ˆAnyoneˆwhoˆasksˆforˆit,ˆbyˆphone,ˆtext,ˆemailˆorˆchat,ˆisn'tˆus.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>

Customer question: I failed verification twice. How many more tries do I get?
